574-7084-7201.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a 3/4 green Treefolk creature token with reach
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-7084-7201.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

512-4091-7704.easyPrerequisites: Doc Samson and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-4091-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4091-7704.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Doc Samson's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

3912-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

413-1349-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
413-1349-6854.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7.
Repeat.

573-2921-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Gruul Turf.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Gruul Turf from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

206-3259-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4094-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4094-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6753-7730.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2724-3217-7715.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Mighty Thor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-3967-7217.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

465-2438-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-2438-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

586-1368-1745-2403.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
586-1368-1745-2403.description:
Cast Priest of Gix from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast spells from your graveyard.
Repeat.

57-2341-4846-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
57-2341-4846-6965.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3769-5147-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3769-5147-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5189-6872.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
2034-5189-6872.description:
Activate Ghave by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

5078-6289-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1329-2178-3652-5256.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-5256.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

116-3388-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Moritte of the Frost on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Moritte of the Frost do not have summoning sickness.
116-3388-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Moritte of the Frost.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Moritte of the Frost.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2645-5614.notablePrerequisites: Bighorner Rancher does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
2645-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-5614.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

2018-2921-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2018-2921-2946-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Cult Conscript from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from steps 1 and 5, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

46-5959.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the additional sorcery
46-5959.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
You have a sorcery card in hand.
46-5959.description:
Cast the additional sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Alania triggers; choose not to have an opponent draw a card.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate from your graveyard by paying {2}{U}, targeting the additional sorcery.
Alania triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and you to copy Cooperate, with the copy targeting the original Cooperate.
Resolve the copy of Cooperate, copying the original Cooperate, with the copy targeting the original Cooperate.
Repeat step 5.

969-1409-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
969-1409-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3967-4881-5011.description:
Activate Yahenni, Undying Partisan by sacrificing Cavalier of Night.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Yahenni, Undying Partisan ability from step 1.
Activate Yahenni, Undying Partisan by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Yahenni, Undying Partisan ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

771-1692-3277-4886.notablePrerequisites:
Wildfire Eternal does not have summoning sickness.
Helm of the Host attached to Izzet Chronarch.
An opponent cannot block Wildfire Eternal.
771-1692-3277-4886.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch with haste.
When the token Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Savage Beating to your hand from your graveyard.
Declare Wildfire Eternal as an attacker.
When Wildfire Eternal is not blocked, it triggers, casting Savage Beating from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Savage Beating, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

678-710-3499-4050-4445.description:
Activate Danitha by tapping it, adding {4}{W} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding one mana of any color.
When Danitha dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Danitha to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Danitha by paying {4}{W}.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Leyline Immersion onto the battlefield from your graveyard attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

3846-4600-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Atemsis does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least six cards in hand with different mana values.
3846-4600-4711.description:
Declare Atemsis as an attacker.
Atemsis' myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of Atemsis tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage using each Atemsis, triggering their abilities.
Resolve each Atemsis trigger, causing you to reveal your hand and causing each opponent to lose the game.

1283-1387-2528-3368.description:
Cast Channel the Suns by paying {4}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 2.
